description: Partial OLS slopes (d index / d fraction) of NDVI, NDWI and NDBI on the five land-cover fractions (with intercept; other vegetation is the omitted reference class), fitted on all cells and epochs. Used by the coupled scenario mode: when a fraction changes, the land is exchanged with the other fractions and the implicit other-vegetation share in proportion to their current values, and each index shifts by the sum of slope x actual fraction change.
